metadata.title: Jahdae Walker Not Yet Roster-Worthy
metadata.description: Chicago Bears wide receiver Jahdae Walker made the most of his lone target, hauling in a one-yard touchdown pass from Bears quarterback Caleb Williams. But Walker did not show the involvement in the Bears' offense that warrants a waiver wire addition in most standard leagues. Chicago has plenty of targets at wide receiver in Rome Odunze, Luther Burden, and Kalif Raymond along with tight end Colston Loveland. So Walker is pretty much an afterthought in the offense despite catching a TD in Week 1's route of the Carolina Panthers. Walker made his target count but moving forward it is hard to predict any kind of role in the Bears offense for Walker when he is at best the fourth-string wide receiver and behind Loveland on the usage tree. The touchdown was nice but doesn't predict future involvement.

metadata.title: Jahdae Walker - Secures touchdown in win
metadata.description: Walker caught his only target for a one-yard touchdown during Sunday's 59-37 win over the Panthers.
metadata.analysis: Walker made the most of his only touch on offense, reeling in a pass from Caleb Williams for a one-yard score late in the fourth quarter. The wide receiver was on the field for 34 of the team's 75 total offensive snaps, and he added two tackles while playing 16 snaps with the special-teams unit in the contest.

metadata.title: Jahdae Walker catches only target in Week 1
metadata.description: Jahdae Walker caught his only target for one yard in the Bears' 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers in Week 1.
metadata.analysis: Walker was more of an afterthought in the Chicago offense for head coach Ben Johnson, finishing tied for last in targets in the win. The pass-catcher remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

metadata.title: Jahdae Walker - One catch to close preseason
metadata.description: Walker brought in his only target for 12 yards in the Bears' 24-15 preseason win over the Titans on Saturday.
metadata.analysis: The second-year pro would have been even more productive during his time in the game, but an offensive holding penalty wiped out an 18-yard reception early on Chicago's second possession. However, Tyson Bagent went right back to Walker on the next play for a 12-yard gain, closing out the receiver's three-game preseason with a 2-48-0 line on three targets. Walker impressively recorded two touchdowns on just six receptions as an undrafted rookie in 2025, and he appears likely to stick on the 53-man roster again to open the 2026 season due to his big-play potential.

metadata.title: Jahdae Walker - Listed as second-string WR
metadata.description: Walker was listed as a second-string wide receiver on the Bears' first unofficial depth chart that was released Tuesday, Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Walker saw limited action for most of his rookie season and did not play in either of the Bears' two playoff games, though he did log six catches (on 10 targets) for 87 yards and two touchdowns across Chicago's final three regular-season games. He entered training camp competing against Kalif Raymond and rookie Zavion Thomas (knee) for the WR3 role. However, Walker will have the chance to earn a more consistent role for himself on offense over the next few weeks, as Luther Burden will miss all three of the Bears' preseason games due to a groin injury.

metadata.title: Jahdae Walker - Productive at end of rookie season
metadata.description: Walker caught six of 10 targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns across nine regular-season games during the 2025 season.
metadata.analysis: Walker made the team out of training camp as an undrafted free agent out of Texas A&M. He played a total of eight offensive snaps through Week 14, but Rome Odunze dealt with a foot injury at the end of the regular season, opening the door for Walker to get some run with Caleb Williams. He made the most of his chances and caught the game-tying touchdown with 24 seconds left in the fourth quarter in Week 16 against the Packers. Walker caught another score in the Week 18 loss to Detroit. After a productive close to the season, Walker should have a leg up as a reserve wideout entering the 2026 offseason.

metadata.title: Jahdae Walker - Won't face Green Bay
metadata.description: Walker (coach's decision) is inactive  for Saturday's wild-card round game against the Packers.
metadata.analysis: Walker has been active for four of Chicago's last five games, taking the roster spot of Rome Odunze. With Odunze ready to return to the field, Walker will be a healthy scratch.

metadata.title: Jahdae Walker - Capitalizes late-season chances
metadata.description: Walker caught two of three targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in the Bears' 19-16 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Walker finished the season with six receptions on 10 targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns across nine games, with all of his production coming over the final three contests. He logged only eight offensive snaps prior to that stretch while frequently inactive, highlighting how situational his usage was. He is signed with Chicago through 2027 and enters 2026 as a depth receiver with fringe roster appeal.

metadata.title: Jahdae Walker - Misses walkthrough with illness
metadata.description: Walker (illness) did not participate in Tuesday's walkthrough.
metadata.analysis: Walker will have two more opportunities to retake the practice field ahead of Saturday's wild-card round playoff matchup against the Packers. In the event that  Rome Odunze (foot) is able to retake the field versus Green Bay, however, Walker will figure to revert to a depth role on offense.

metadata.title: Jahdae Walker hauls in touchdown pass in Week 18
metadata.description: Jahdae Walker caught 2-of-3 targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in the Bears' 19-16 loss to Detroit on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Walker has emerged as another threat for Caleb Williams over the past three weeks as he has caught 6-of-10 targets for 87 yards and two scores. His 25-yard touchdown reception against the Lions in Week 18 was the longest catch of his brief career. It remains to be seen if he will stay on the streak he is on during the postseason.
